heading: Security Through Precision & Deep Systems Analysis
bioParagraphs: I am a Cybersecurity Security Researcher with a focused background in identifying complex vulnerabilities across Web Applications, Android Ecosystems, and Distributed Infrastructure. My work centers on proactive defense, empirical penetration testing, and secure-by-design architecture.

Rather than treating security as a compliance checkbox, I operate with an adversarial mindset to uncover hidden business logic flaws, memory safety issues, and broken access controls before attackers can exploit them. I frequently contribute to bug bounty platforms and security research communities.

focusAreas.title: Penetration Testing & Offensive Security
focusAreas.description: Black-box and white-box assessments of web endpoints, APIs, and cloud microservices using methodology-driven exploit techniques.

focusAreas.title: Web & Mobile (Android) Security
focusAreas.description: Deep-dive static and dynamic binary analysis, dynamic instrumentation via Frida, SSL pinning bypass, and IPC mechanism auditing.

focusAreas.title: Vulnerability Research & Exploitation
focusAreas.description: Uncovering zero-days and high-impact vulnerabilities in open-source applications, protocols, and proprietary business logic.

focusAreas.title: Security Engineering & Threat Mitigation
focusAreas.description: Collaborating with engineering teams to integrate SAST/DAST automation, build secure authentication flows, and harden CI/CD pipelines.

philosophy: Effective security relies on deep system understanding, minimal attack surfaces, and empirical evidence over theoretical risk.
